notes.title: Modding Support - Update Limitations
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone , [/b]

Yesterday I discovered a limitation that unity has regarding the animations. 

Unity does not allow you to make changes to the animation controller in runtime , this means that fully controllable animations will not be present .

[b]Solutions : [/b]

As a result i cant(Unity) allow players to import animations , instead of that i will make a controller for the ramps to “fake” the animation. This comes with some compromises and the fact it's not animation doesn't allow you to make a complex animation with contracting ropes etc. 

All animation situation will have some strict limitations to the names and how to use it in blender or other 3D modeling software except SketchUp(does not keep the hierarchy and pivot points for objects that is very important to solve the animation problem , exports the whole model in one piece and its not good at all )

One more also is will leave a question mark on how a 2 way ramp will work.

I will post soon a video of the progression when I finally deal with this animation problem.

Soon i will uncover more of how to use ramps .

notes.title: Modding Support - Custom Ship Import
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello everyone , Big Αnnouncement !!! [/b][/h1]

Custom Ship import is developed almost 70% and it's getting ready in the following months to be added to the main game !!! Many things needs to be placed and customized to give the desired behavior  

[b]The files supported are only .fbx support for .obj will be added later , .x files are not supported(very old) [/b]

[b]4 features that I can share with you are the following : [/b]

[list]
[*] Position Finder - Easy find your placement position for what you need to adjust 
[*] Reload - You can see live all the changes that you have made to the .txt files automatically generated in the ship folder in the creation process. So when you make a change save the file and it the reload button the change will appear so you can tweak all the parts more easily you don't need to open the ship in the editor scene to make changes  
[*] Easy open file location !!! 
[/list]

[b]Some Limitations (not permanent): [/b]

You will not able to use your rudders and propellers - you will use the ones provided (you will be able to change the scale to fit your purposes and maybe different types)

2 Types of ship , 1 Rudder 1 Propeller , 2 Rudder 2 Propeller pre models are supported 

Small tutorial for exporting https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qb0cgJBZQRU PBR material and textures for using them to the game.
